description:
Your Jenkins instance's built-in (controller) node needs to be reconfigured to follow best practices. Heavy builds have been slowing down the Jenkins dashboard because everything is running on the controller.

Perform the following configuration changes:

1. Navigate to the built-in node configuration (Manage Jenkins > Nodes > Built-In Node > Configure)
2. Set the 'Number of executors' to 1
3. Set the 'Labels' field to: controller lightweight
4. Change the 'Usage' to 'Only build jobs with label expressions matching this node'
5. Save the node configuration

Then create a test job to verify the configuration:

6. Create a new Freestyle project named 'controller-health-check'
7. Check 'Restrict where this project can be run' and set the Label Expression to: controller
8. Add a Build Step of type 'Execute shell' with the command:
   echo "Health check running on controller node" && hostname && date && uptime
9. Save the job

Login credentials - Username: admin, Password: Admin123!
